remarks: Charming and move-in ready, this sun-filled 4-bedroom, 2-bath home is ideally located in the heart of Darien. Filled with natural light, the inviting floor plan features an open living room and dining room, along with a separate office or den offering flexibility for today's lifestyle. The finished lower level provides valuable additional living space, perfect for a family room, home office, or gym. A detached two-car garage and an expansive private backyard offer endless possibilities for outdoor enjoyment, entertaining, or future expansion. Freshly painted with newly refinished floors, this turnkey home combines charm, versatility, and a desirable location. Situated on a beautiful property, 62 Camp Avenue provides an exceptional opportunity for easy living in a prime location close to everything Darien has to offer. Generator included.
